messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 0a 00} it's {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day {ff 00 00 00}today.
{07 17 00}Lucky for me,{01 00 00 05 00} I was THIS
close to being a pop star.
{07 14 00}But you better give it your
all, {04 1f 00}. You could
create a new town tune!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 0a 00} täna on {ff 00 00 03}laulupäev{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 17 00}Minu õnneks{01 00 00 05 00} jäi popstaarist
puudu vaid SELLE võrra.
{07 14 00}Aga anna endast parim,
{04 1f 00}. Sa võid luua
uue linna viisi!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{00 01 00}Yay yay!{01 00 00 0f 00} It's {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day
{ff 00 00 00}todaaaay!{00 01 00} {01 01 00}That's the song
I'm gonna sing.
I'm expecting it to be the
next{01 00 00 05 00} town tune, so get
ready to hear it A LOT!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{00 01 00}Jee jee!{01 00 00 0f 00} Täna on {ff 00 00 03}LAULUPÄEV
{ff 00 00 00}jeeee!{00 01 00} {01 01 00}Seda laulu ma
laulangi.
Ma ootan, et sellest saab
järgmine{01 00 00 05 00} linna viis, nii et
valmistu seda PALJU kuulma!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}La la la!{00 01 00} Ahem.{01 00 00 14 00} I was just
warming up my pipes. {01 01 00}'Cause
it's {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day {ff 00 00 00}today!
{07 00 00}If you sing it right, your
song could become the next
town tune, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}I know I'm normally too cool
for school,{01 00 00 05 00} but even I'm
getting all worked up!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Laa laa!{00 01 00} Khm.{01 00 00 14 00} Ma lihtsalt
soojendasin häält. {01 01 00}Sest
täna on {ff 00 00 03}laulupäev{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 00 00}Kui laulad hästi, võib su
laulust saada uus
linna viis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Tean, et olen tavaliselt
liiga lahe,{01 00 00 05 00} aga isegi mina
olen päris elevil!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} do you
wanna hear my song {07 00 00}before
you go?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas tahad
kuulda mu laulu, {07 00 00}enne kui
lähed?

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}It's weird to sing without a
stage and lights and all...

{07 15 00}But{01 00 00 14 00} do me a favor,
{04 1f 00}, and listen to
my song, OK?
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Imelik on laulda ilma lava
ja tuledeta ja nii...

{07 15 00}Aga{01 00 00 14 00} tee mulle teene,
{04 1f 00}, ja kuula
mu laulu, eks?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Phew{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}I put a little more
soul into it today than
I normally do.
{07 0d 00}Did you feel it?{01 00 00 05 00} Did it
twist your heart right up,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Uhh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Panin täna sellesse
veidi rohkem hinge
kui tavaliselt.
{07 0d 00}Kas sa tundsid seda?{01 00 00 05 00} Kas
see väänas su südant,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Yeah, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess it's totally
obvious.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}I'm the Melody
Queen of this town!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Jah, {01 00 00 05 00}see on vist täiesti
ilmselge.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Mina olen selle
linna viisikuninganna!

messages.en:
{07 0c 00}What?!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}That was my best
number{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 14 00}You've got a gift{01 00 00 05 00} for
knowing good music when you
hear it!
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}Mida?!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}See oli mu parim
number{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 14 00}Sul on anne{01 00 00 05 00} head muusikat
ära tunda, kui sa seda
kuuled!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}OK. {01 00 00 05 00}That's fine. {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}I shouldn't
expect a child to get my
music anyway, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Olgu. {01 00 00 05 00}Pole hullu. {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}Lapselt
ei saagi oodata, et ta mu
muusikat jagaks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}Well!{01 00 00 14 00} Let me remind you
that this is a festival! It's
supposed to be fun!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}No kuule!{01 00 00 14 00} Tuletan meelde,
et see on pidu! See peaks
olema lõbus!

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}have you already heard
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s song?

{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 06}{0b 03 00}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s got a pretty 
impressive voice, and solid
songwriting skills.
{07 19 00}Now there's talent that's
worthy of being considered
my competition!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}kas sa oled juba
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00} laulu kuulnud?

{07 14 00}Tüübil nimega {ff 00 00 06}{0b 03 00}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00}
on päris muljetavaldav hääl
ja tugev viisiloomeoskus.
{07 19 00}Vaat see on talent, mida
võib pidada minu
konkurendiks!{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Phew, I feel so much better
after belting out a tune.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It's so cathartic!
{07 00 00}Hey, is there something I
can do for you,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Uhh, tunnen end palju
paremini, kui olen laulnud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on nii puhastav!
{07 00 00}Hei, kas ma saan sinu
heaks midagi teha,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Music is such a wonderful 
thing, don't you think,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Hey, why are you staring at
me like that? Do you need
something from me?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Muusika on nii imeline
asi, kas sa ei leia,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Hei, miks sa mind niimoodi
jõllitad? Kas sul on minult
midagi vaja?
